tiers.name: Standard PyTorch Eager (BF16 lm_head + FP32 Upcast Softmax CrossEntropyLoss)
tiers.note: Materializes full [32768, 152064] BF16 logits (10.0 GB) + FP32 upcast copy (20.0 GB) + backward grad_logits -> 39.1 GB peak OOM!

tiers.name: torch.compile / Triton Fused Softmax-CE (Still Materializes Full [N, V] BF16 Logits)
tiers.note: Eliminates the FP32 upcast copy via online softmax, but lm_head linear still writes and reads a 10 GB BF16 logits tensor + 10 GB grad tensor!

tiers.name: Token-Chunked Fused Linear Cross-Entropy (Liger-Kernel Style Forward-Backward In-Place Grad)
tiers.note: Slices hidden states into B_c=1,024 token chunks, computes logits + CE + dH/dW inside forward/custom-autograd, never materializing full [N, V] logits!

tiers.name: Zero-Logit-Materialization Fused Linear CE (Cut-Cross-Entropy Indexed Target Dot + Online LSE Tile)
tiers.note: Computes target logit via indexed dot product and streams online log-sum-exp in SRAM tiles -> cuts CE memory 244.4x (39.1 -> 0.16 GB) & speeds up step 1.46x!
